elements.element: Customer is subject to no contractual prohibition on soliciting the other party's employees or personnel.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly binds “Neither party,” including Customer, not to solicit covered personnel for employment.

elements.element: Customer is prohibited from soliciting the other party's covered personnel.
elements.evidence: “Neither party” may solicit personnel of “the other party” only within the stated exceptions or with consent.

elements.element: The other party is prohibited from soliciting Customer's covered personnel.
elements.evidence: The reciprocal “Neither party” and “other party's personnel” formulation applies equally in both directions.

elements.element: The non-solicit applies only to personnel directly involved in the services.
elements.evidence: The restriction is limited to “personnel directly involved in performing this Agreement,” which operationally confines the covered group to personnel directly involved in the contracted work.

elements.element: The non-solicit period is twelve months.
elements.evidence: The clause specifies “a period of twelve (12) months.”

elements.element: The twelve-month period begins at the end of each covered individual's involvement in the services.
elements.evidence: The period runs “after the end of an individual's involvement in performing this Agreement.”

elements.element: General advertisements are excluded from the non-solicit.
elements.evidence: The exception permits hiring through “general employment advertising or communications” where a person responds to that general outreach.

elements.element: Unsolicited approaches by personnel are excluded from the non-solicit.
elements.evidence: The exception permits employing a person who contacts the hiring party “on his or her own initiative without any solicitation or encouragement.”

elements.element: The restriction is solicitation-only and does not independently prohibit hiring.
elements.evidence: The operative prohibition addresses only solicitation for employment. Hiring is not independently prohibited, and the exceptions expressly contemplate employing or hiring covered personnel.

result.reason: The redline does not achieve the preferred position because it expressly binds Customer. It satisfies every fallback element: mutuality, directly involved personnel, the individual-specific twelve-month period, both required carve-outs, and no independent no-hire. It is not strictly minimal because it adds “general solicitation” even though the existing general-employment-advertising language was sufficient; that phrase is also undefined and potentially broader than the required advertising carve-out. The clause otherwise preserves the fallback's commercial intent without contradicting unrelated terms.
